notes.title: Demo update — Chinese translation
notes.content:
The translation for Simplified Chinese has arrived to the demo! Thanks a lot to Huang "Shuyuan" Teng for working on the translation! Alongside with it, some visual changes.



The work on the game is still ongoing, but has been somewhat offset due to personal circumstances. I am hoping to bring this game to a finished state as soon as possible!

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content: Many players have asked for readability improvements in the GUI. This update brings this in the form of a new, more readable font, as well as environment updates and bugfixes.

notes.title: New update: Feedback form and some bugfixes
notes.content: Since it's a little difficult to gather feedback on a demo on steam, I've made a feedback survey. It also now appears in the demo's thank you message. I would be very grateful if you took the time to fill it!
